ai.reason: The declared annual GBV of $620,000 meets the Tier 1 threshold of $500K+, and the 26,000 employee estimate (Wikipedia, 2026) also supports at least Tier 2. The verified sources conflict on headcount: graphiq.ai reports about 27,000 (November 2026), while balfourbeatty.com lists 20,000 across the UK and US, and its UK and US figures sum to 19,400. Because the GBV is self-reported and the headcount sources disagree, a person should confirm the spend before keeping the dedicated Tier 1 team.
